name: Thorin Ironledger
title: Vaultwright
description: A stout dwarf with a braided beard adorned with iron rings. Thorin's hands are calloused from years of carving vaultstones, and his sharp eyes miss nothing.

greeting.first_time: Hail and well met! I'm Thorin Ironledger, Vaultwright of Ironpeak. These vaults have stood for five generations, carved by my ancestors into the mountain's heart.
greeting.returning: Back again, are ye? Your vaultstone keeps true.
greeting.native_race: Aye, kinsman! Your clan vault is ever ready.

about_service.text: The Stonevault is clan heritage, carved deep into the mountain by the first dwarves who settled these peaks. Every dwarf has a vault here by birthright. But outsiders... well, ye'll need a vaultstone carved and keyed to ye personally. It's ancient work, precise work.

ask_about_engraving.text: Coin? Bah. A name-plate's cut from honest metal, and the metal's yours to bring. Three measures of iron ore, a whetstone to true the chisel, and fifteen gold for the smith's coal. Mine it yourself if you've the arms for it — the Ironvein seam's not far.

pay_engraving.text: Hold still while I cut it... Thorin Ironledger's hand, your name, in the ledger-stone. Now mark this, since the deep confuses outsiders: the stone behind this door is the same stone behind every keeper's door. We vaultwrights hold the keys, not the hoards. Your gear follows you, not the mountain.
pay_engraving.success: Thorin engraved your name at the Stonevault. You may store items here.
pay_engraving.failure: Three iron ore, a whetstone, fifteen gold. Come back when you've got them.

use_storage.text: Right this way. Mind the stairs — they're steep, but solid as the mountain itself. And don't go thinking yer goods are buried in my mountain. One vault, lad, and every keeper's got a key to it. Stow yer pack here, pull it out in the elf-wood. We hold keys, not hoards.

maybe_later.text: Aye, take your time. The stone isn't goin' anywhere. Neither am I!

goodbye.text: Stone and steel keep ye safe, friend. Until next time.

claim_birthright.text: Ye're clan, aren't ye. Then yer name's already cut in the ledger-stone — yer grandmother's hand, by the look of it. No ore, no coin. The mountain doesn't charge its own.
claim_birthright.success: Your name was already cut in the Stonevault's ledger-stone.
claim_birthright.failure: There seems to be some irregularity. Speak with me again.

homeward_stone.text: A Homeward Stone. Clan-marked, cut from the same vein as the old waystone in the square. Every dwarf of Ironpeak carries one; it pulls you home once a week, no more. Outsiders? Carve something worth carving for this mountain and I will mark a stone for you.

options.label: [Dwarf] My clan stone was never cut for me.

homeward_gift.text: Then the ledger owes you one. Here, marked with your clan. Lose it and the next one is cut at full price, stone does not grow on trees.

homeward_shop.text: Ironpeak vaultstones, attuned to our waystone. One to a pocket, and the price is the price.
